drink.name: The Birder
ingredients: 3 to 4 cranberries macerated with sugar and lemon
steps: Add the macerated cranberries, spiced rum, apple cider, and lemon juice to a glass with ice.
Top with ginger beer and stir gently.

drink.name: Punkin Cream

prep.title: Prepare the Pumpkin Butter
prep.text: Stir ¼ tsp pumpkin pie spice, 1½ tsp maple syrup, and ¼ tsp vanilla paste or extract into approximately ¼ can of pumpkin purée. Cook over medium low heat for 5 to 10 minutes, then let cool.

steps: Add the prepared pumpkin butter and oat milk to a shaker. Stir until combined.
Add ice, then the brandy. Shake for 15 to 20 seconds.
Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice.

drink.name: The Pearberry Ginger Press
ingredients: A splash of fresh, unsweetened cranberry juice
steps: Add the pear juice, cranberry juice, and maple syrup to a glass filled with ice. Stir to combine.
Top with ginger beer and club soda, then stir gently.
